# Cooling Field Towels: Fresh Feel Anywhere You Go

Stay refreshed when a full shower isn't an option. These 25-count cooling field towels from Duke Cannon pair aloe vera, menthol, and jojoba to leave skin feeling clean and comfortably cool.

## Refresh On the Go

Pack a pack for road trips, camping, or long days away from home. Each wipe is ready to use, so you can freshen up after a workout, a drive, or a day outdoors without searching for a sink.

## Gentle Enough for Daily Use

Alcohol- and paraben-free formula makes these a practical choice for your face and body. Use them each morning to cleanse before applying moisturizer or makeup, or each night to wind down.

## Thoughtfully Made

Crafted in the USA and tested by U.S. National Guard members, these towels are built for real-world conditions. Keep them in your bag, car, or gym kit so a quick refresh is always within reach.

## Stock Up Today

Add the 25-count Cooling Field Towels to your cart and keep your fresh feeling close at hand.
